title: MIDNIGHT REPLAY: Night Drive BGM (original score)
description:
City lights, empty roads, and one night you keep playing back in your head. Midnight Replay.

A moody, driving track for night drive edits, city reels, late-night study sessions, gaming montages and slow-motion moments. Headphones on, volume up.

Music: Midnight Replay, an original score by ÆTHER. Composed for ÆTHER, made with AI.
